mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, name, username, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{username}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, title, content, name, username, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks(title, content, start_date, end_date, username, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{username}, #{name}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND username = #{username}
